svg.desc: Dettaglio documentario autentico «Quality» dalla famiglia digitale corrente Swift. Gerard Unger / Linotype; official poster published by MyFonts / Monotype. Fonte: https://www.myfonts.com/collections/swift-font-linotype. Immagine: https://cdn.myfonts.net/images/pim/10188/Swift%20LT%203.png. Copyright retained; no open-license claim. Documentary excerpt for teaching, not font software. Current digital Swift family, distinct from NeueSwift; do not claim this is a1985print or exact originalsoftware.
